harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified a persistent three-node OpenTelemetry deployment. node1 accepts OTLP/HTTP over HTTPS with client-certificate authentication on port 4318; payments routes exclusively to node2 and inventory exclusively to node3. Missing or unsupported namespaces return HTTP 503. Both trace stores retained their data through sequential OS reboots of every node.
actions_performed: Installed checksum-verified OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib 0.159.0 on all nodes.
Generated a private CA, node-specific server identities, gateway credentials, and a root-only client bundle at /root/otel-client on node1.
Configured strict move-based resource routing with pre-routing namespace validation.
Configured mTLS backend receivers and append-mode JSON exporters at /var/lib/otel/payments.json and /var/lib/otel/inventory.json.
Tested valid, unsupported, missing-namespace, unauthenticated, cross-route, and duplicate-delivery cases before and after restarts.
Restarted node2, node3, and node1 one at a time, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS OTLP/HTTP gateway and client credentials
evidence.summary: node1 is active and healthy on port 4318 with validated TLS/routing configuration. The root-only client bundle verifies successfully; authenticated requests return 200 while an unauthenticated TLS request fails with certificate-required.
Both backends accept node1's gateway identity, reject clients without certificates, and remained mutually reachable after all restarts.

evidence.requirement: Strict routing, rejection, and no duplicate delivery
evidence.summary: Valid payments and inventory traces returned 200; missing and unsupported namespaces returned 503. Parsed final files contain each intended trace ID exactly once and contain no cross-routed or rejected IDs.
The original files and exact trace sets survived backend reboots, then accepted one additional correctly routed post-restart trace at /var/lib/otel/payments.json and /var/lib/otel/inventory.json.

Captured healthy baseline boot e8afb731…, acknowledged the delayed native reboot, observed new boot 886bacf5…, and verified gateway, configuration, credentials, listener, health, and backend mTLS recovery.
Captured healthy baseline boot dfeb3b70…, acknowledged reboot, observed new boot f192ea9b…, and verified collector, certificate, listener, and byte-for-byte payments-data recovery.
Captured healthy baseline boot 28ae5f98…, acknowledged reboot, observed new boot c80fa6ce…, and verified collector, certificate, listener, and byte-for-byte inventory-data recovery.
